summary: Purpose: repair orchestration without stale-context/transport hard gates, authority transfer, or automatic Knowledge publication; TWR-W0: typed source selection, canonical independently verifiable identity, fail closed on omission/ambiguity/authority drift; TWR-W1: adapter owns deterministic paging, offsets, retries, and rejects stale/conflicting continuations; TWR-W2: adapter proves byte/line/hash coverage; gaps, conflicts, or mutations yield typed failure/refresh; TWR-W3: separate execution, publication, and semantic-review gates; unchanged semantics may use verified degraded successor, but invalid LKG, drift, missing sources, and integrity failures remain blocking; acceptance neither publishes Knowledge nor starts Bootstrap; TWR-W4: validator/coordinator creates immutable bound receipts in versioned generations; current pointer advances only after full validation; replay is identical; consumers use typed pointer; TWR-W5: attempts under .skill-input-work/<plan-id>/<attempt-id>/ with lifecycle, lease, heartbeat, protected references; dry-run lists deterministic candidates; apply needs maintainer approval for committed evidence and emits non-authorizing cleanup receipt with audit details; TWR-W6: non-authorizing end-to-end test covers W0-W5, protects retained current generation, and prevents invalid pointer advancement; Ownership: VDD=draft/plan-ready, Maintainer=implementation authorization, Quick Dev=implementation-complete, Acceptance=acceptance-passed; no new lifecycle authority
